notes.title: Dyhamtaolas 1.0.8
notes.content:
1. Added a Skip Option for losing cutscenes, along with an Auto-Skip setting.
2. Fixed a leaderboard bug that affected showing scores.
3. Minor improvement to the RNG system.
4. Updated the Unburnable special card.
5. Implemented ubershaders for smoother visuals and reduced stutter on lower end devices. 
6. Various minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.0.7
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes: Version 1.0.7[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue on Steam Deck where skiping tutorial prevented gameplay until restarting.
[*] Added the ability to click to navigate back in the menu.
[*] Reordered dialogue choices for selecting Easy Mode.
[*] Further refined enemy poise mechanics for better gameplay balance and challenge progression.
[*] Thank you for your continued support and feedback! If you encounter any other issues, let us know.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version [1.0.6]
notes.content:
[b] Bug Fixes  [/b]
- Resolved an issue where the pause menu wouldn't focus properly on Steam Deck.  
- Fixed a minor controller bug affecting one dialogue sequence.  
- Addressed a leaderboard bug that prevented some top players from being displayed.  

[b] Improvements and Balancing  [/b]
- Adjusted the order of tutorial dialogue choices to prevent players from making unintended choices.  
- Replaced manual save as the sole option with an auto-save feature.  
- Prevented certain events from being re-triggered unintentionally.  
- Retrying after Losing completely now allows players to continue from the last stage they reached.  

[b]Balancing Changes:[/b]
- Increased the player's starting health.  
- Tweaked enemy poise.  
- Adjusted enemy level-ups to nerf their attack and defense progression.  
- more powerful cards to choose for the player's deck.
